releaseNotes: v1.36.0 — Voice Journal + Delve Deeper. Voice Journal: record a spoken diary entry in English or Amharic and let AI organize your own words into a tidy daily journal — an editor, never an author; the raw transcript is always preserved and you can edit before saving. Delve Deeper: a one-tap deep study note for any passage with its own prompt, cache, and daily allowance, plus AI Study reliability hardening. Build is slimmed (unused resources removed) and the universal APK supports every Android model.
